problem.name: Disjoint-support testing of finite distributions
problem.statement_latex: Given coherent samplers for $p,q$ on $[N]$, distinguish $\operatorname{supp}(p)\cap\operatorname{supp}(q)=\varnothing$ from $\|p-q\|_1\le2-\varepsilon$. This is the orthogonality-testing promise of Bravyi--Harrow--Hassidim.
problem.statement_text: Given coherent samplers for $p,q$ on $[N]$, distinguish $\operatorname{supp}(p)\cap\operatorname{supp}(q)=\varnothing$ from $\|p-q\|_1\le2-\varepsilon$. This is the orthogonality-testing promise of Bravyi–Harrow–Hassidim.
